changed: Slides 1 and 2 now show positions (2026-10-08): checks and captures to look at first, and Philidor’s mate in two (Qg8+! Rxg8 Nf7#).
Punjabi, the Try, practice and challenge were labels with no instruction; each now says what to do (ਮਾਤ ਦਿਓ / ਲੱਭੋ).

Slides 1 and 2, the bishop sacrifice on h7: Stockfish confirmed Bxh7+ is the best move, but showed White was already winning without it, because Black was simply missing a knight. The knight is back on c6: now material is even, and Bxh7+ is the only winning move (+4.9 against +1.3 for anything else). A real move order reaches the position (1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.e5 Nfd7 5.Nf3 Bb4 6.Be2 Nc6 7.Bd3 O-O). The same position is on 7.9.
Punjabi prompts: verbs added.
Slide 2 now shows a position (2026-10-08): Boden’s mate, two bishops crossing.

Punjabi, slide 1: “a rook next to the king” now says it is the opponent’s king, guarded by the knight (ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਦੇ ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਹਾਥੀ, ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਰਾਖੀ ਘੋੜਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ). Slide 2: ਇੱਕ ਵਾਰ (clashes with ਵਾਰ = strike) is now ਜਦੋਂ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜਾਣ ਲਓ. Challenge: verb added.
Slides 1 and 2 now show positions (2026-10-08): the queen lures the rook to g8, and the fork square that would trap the queen.
Punjabi, slide 2: “their king or queen” (ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ) could be heard as your own; now ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਦਾ. Practice and challenge: verbs added.
ask: Not changed: ਚੋਗਾ ਇੱਕ ਮੋਹਰਾ ਪੇਸ਼ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ. The reviewer called ਪੇਸ਼ Urdu-ised; it is the phrase 6.7 uses for “offers a pawn”, so I kept the two lessons alike.

changed: Slide 1 now shows a position (2026-10-08): Qxd6 Rxd6 Re8#, the rook pulled off the back row.
Punjabi: practice and challenge had no verb, and ਤਿੰਨ ਵਾਰ (“three times”) collides with ਵਾਰ = strike. Now ਤਿੰਨ ਵਾਰੀ ਰਾਖੇ ਦਾ ਧਿਆਨ ਹਟਾਓ.
Slide 1 now shows a position (2026-10-08): Rxe8+ first, and only then bxc3.

Punjabi goal: ਉਮੀਦ means “hope”, not “expected”; now ਵਾਪਸ ਮਾਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ. Slide 1 read as an obligation (“it has to be played in between”) where the English says it can change everything. Practice and challenge: verbs added.
Slides 1 and 2 now show positions (2026-10-08): a knight cutting a rook’s line, and a knight stepping aside to clear the queen’s line.

Punjabi, slide 2: “its square” pointed at the wrong piece (the other piece’s own square); now ਹਟਾਏ ਹੋਏ ਮੋਹਰੇ ਦਾ ਖਾਨਾ ਜਾਂ ਲਕੀਰ. Slide 1 is clearer and in the present tense. Practice and challenge: verbs added, ਤਿੰਨ ਵਾਰੀ.
Slide 1 now shows a position (2026-10-08): the rook works through the knight towards the king.
Punjabi: ਜਿਉਂ ਹੀ (bookish) is now ਜਦੋਂ … ਹਿੱਲ ਜਾਵੇ ਜਾਂ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਵੇ. Practice and challenge: verbs added.
Slide 1 uses the corrected bishop-sacrifice position described under 7.2.
Punjabi goal: “wins more” is now ਹੋਰ ਵੀ ਵੱਧ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ. Practice: ਤੋਹਫ਼ਾ broke from the lesson’s own “giving a piece” and had no verb; now ਜਿਤਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਮੋਹਰਾ ਦਿਓ.
Slide 1 now shows a position (2026-10-08): the quiet Qb7, after which Black has only Kg8 and Qg7 mates.

Punjabi: a threat ਨਾ ਰੁਕਣ ਵਾਲੀ (“that doesn’t stop”) is now one ਜੋ ਰੋਕੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ (“that can’t be stopped”); ਉੱਚੀ (also “high”) is now ਰੌਲੇ ਵਾਲੀ; the challenge said ਚੁੱਪ ਵਾਰ, breaking from the lesson’s own term, now ਤਿੰਨ ਚੁੱਪ ਚਾਲਾਂ ਲੱਭੋ.
